content_html: You don’t need to have the class marked as serializable or derive from MarshalByRefObject to work across domains. If you use AppDomain.GetData/SetData, the runtime will marshal the object for you. I created a class, TelnetTraceListener, that derives from TraceListener and it works flawlessly across app domains via AppDomain.GetData/AppDomain.SetData.
Also want to add that because I was using remoting, my objects would sometimes expire (The lease time). To prevent this, I had to override the method InitializeLifetimeService.
